mathematics.middle: For a,b in[0,1], |a^m-b^m|<=m|a-b|. Expanding each Bernstein basis product and using choose(d,r)<=2^d bounds its difference by2^d*d*|a-b|. The literal existing source expansion has d+1 coefficients in[0,2B(k)], hence polynomial differences on[-1,0] are at most C(k)|x-y|. The actual sourceInterpolant_bernstein equality is consumed, not an arbitrary assumed polynomial.
